reader_summary.overview: Joel Wittenberg is the chief investment officer and vice president of W.K. Kellogg Foundation, where he has managed the foundation's $8 billion in assets since 2009. The Kellogg Foundation is guided by the belief that all children should have an equal opportunity to thrive.

key_points.text: In accordance with that mission, in 2007 its Board committed to be an effective anti-racist organization that promotes racial equity.
Over the ensuing thirteen years, the organization has become a leader in applying research and taking effective action.
Our conversation touches on Joel's background in the fixed income markets and the application of duration and convexity to allocating capital.
